summary: This lecture from Shaykh Ali Mashhour's Zadul-Ma'ad series discusses the early Islamic period following the first revelation to the Prophet Muhammad. It covers the identity and significance of Waraka ibn Nawfal, who recognized the angel Jibreel and became among the first believers, and explains the scholarly criteria for what constitutes a companion (sahabi) of the Prophet. The lecture details how the early Muslim community faced increasing persecution from Quraish when the Prophet began openly criticizing their idolatry and polytheistic practices, explaining the tribal and political dynamics that made persecution possible.
